title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 14.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 14.4 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to 19.6.2 could allow an unauthenticated user to cause a denial of service via unconstrained backtracking in regular expression evaluation. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
